prompt: On a scale drawing of a house, 2 inches represent 15 feet. The back wall of the house is 45 feet long. How long, in inches, is the back wall on the drawing?
Lena deposits $1,500 in an account that pays 4 percent simple interest per year. She makes no other deposits or withdrawals. After how many years will the account hold exactly $1,800?

A crew of 6 workers, all working at the same rate, can pave a road in 20 days. After the crew has worked for 4 days, 2 more workers who work at the same rate join them. How many more days will it take to finish paving the road?

Two trains on parallel tracks are moving toward each other. One train is 120 meters long and travels at 45 kilometers per hour; the other is 180 meters long and travels at 63 kilometers per hour. From the moment the fronts of the trains meet, how many seconds pass until the rear ends of the trains pass each other?

An empty 900-liter tank is filled by pump A, which delivers 30 liters per minute. After pump A has run alone for 10 minutes, pump B is also switched on, and with both pumps running the tank is full 8 minutes later. How many liters per minute does pump B deliver?

Standing still on a moving escalator, Kim rides from the bottom to the top in 60 seconds. Walking up the same escalator while it is moving, she reaches the top in 24 seconds. At her same walking pace, how many seconds would it take her to walk from the bottom to the top if the escalator were switched off?
Car P uses 8 liters of fuel for every 100 kilometers it travels. Car Q travels 15 kilometers on each liter of fuel. On a 750-kilometer trip, how many more liters of fuel does car P use than car Q?

A tank holds 40 liters of a mixture that is 25 percent concentrate. Some of the mixture is drained and replaced with the same amount of pure concentrate, so that the tank again holds 40 liters, now 40 percent concentrate. How many liters were drained?

Working alone, Ana can paint a fence in 6 hours and Ben can paint it in 9 hours. They take turns, one at a time: Ana paints for the first hour, Ben for the second hour, Ana for the third hour, and so on, until the fence is finished. How many hours does it take to paint the fence?

A phone plan charges 10 cents per minute for the first 300 minutes used in a month and 6 cents per minute for each minute after the first 300. Last month Dana's bill was $42.00. How many minutes did she use?

A chemist mixes 30 liters of a 20 percent acid solution with 20 liters of a 45 percent acid solution. She then pours out 10 liters of the mixture and replaces them with 10 liters of water. What percent of the final solution is acid?

A printer working at a steady rate would take 12 hours to print a large job. After it has printed for 3 hours, it is upgraded so that it prints 50 percent faster, and it prints the rest of the job at that new rate. How many hours does the whole job take?

Two cyclists start at the same moment, one from town A and one from town B, and ride toward each other along the same road, each at a constant speed. They first pass each other 24 kilometers from A. Each continues to the other town, turns around immediately, and rides back. They pass each other a second time 15 kilometers from B. How many kilometers apart are A and B?
A fruit seller buys apples at 3 for $1 and sells all of them at 2 for $1. How many apples must she buy and sell to make a profit of exactly $10?
A jar full of honey weighs 900 grams. After 40 percent of the honey is poured out, the jar and the remaining honey weigh 660 grams. How many grams does the empty jar weigh?
In triangle PQR, the exterior angle at vertex R measures 128 degrees, and angle P measures 51 degrees. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle Q?
An isosceles triangle has a perimeter of 31 centimeters, and the length of each of its sides is a whole number of centimeters. How many different such triangles are possible?
Every edge of a cube is lengthened by the same amount, and as a result the total surface area of the cube increases by 125%. By what percent does the volume of the cube increase?

A rectangular box is 12 inches long and 4 inches wide. The straight-line distance through the inside of the box from one corner to the opposite corner is 13 inches. What is the height of the box, in inches?
The straight-line distance through the inside of a cube from one corner to the opposite corner is 6 centimeters. What is the total surface area of the cube, in square centimeters?

A 25-foot ladder leans against a vertical wall, with its top 24 feet above level ground. The top of the ladder slides 4 feet down the wall, and the foot of the ladder slides directly away from the wall. How many feet does the foot of the ladder move?
The radius of a cylinder is increased by 20 percent, and its height is decreased by 25 percent. The new volume is what percent of the original volume?
All three vertices of triangle ABC lie on a circle, and side AB is a diameter of the circle with length 26. Side AC has length 10. What is the area of triangle ABC?
In triangle ABC, angle A measures 50 degrees. The bisectors of angle B and angle C meet at point I inside the triangle. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle BIC?

A cube with edges of 3 centimeters is glued to the middle of one face of a cube with edges of 5 centimeters, so that one whole face of the small cube is against the large cube. What is the total surface area of the resulting solid, in square centimeters?

A rectangular sheet of cardboard measures 20 centimeters by 12 centimeters. A square 3 centimeters on a side is cut from each of the four corners, and the sides are folded up to form an open box. What is the volume of the box, in cubic centimeters?
A tent is shaped like a triangular prism 10 feet long. Each triangular end has sides of 5 feet, 5 feet and 8 feet, with the 8-foot side on the ground. What is the volume of the tent, in cubic feet?
In triangle ABC, AB = AC and angle A measures 40 degrees. Point D lies on side AC so that BD = BC. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle ABD?

A box holds 3 red tokens and 2 blue tokens. One token is drawn at random, its color is noted, and it is put back. A second token is then drawn at random. What is the probability that exactly one of the two tokens drawn is red?
In the list 9, 2, 12, 5, x, the number x is greater than each of the other four numbers. If the mean of the five numbers is equal to their median, what is the value of x?
A 3-person team is to be chosen from a group of 8 students. Two of the students, Kim and Lee, refuse to be on the same team. How many different teams can be chosen?

A train arrives at a station at a random time between 8:00 a.m. and 8:30 a.m., with every moment equally likely. Ana reaches the station at 8:10 a.m. and will wait there for at most 9 minutes. If the train comes before Ana arrives, she misses it. What is the probability that Ana catches the train?
How many different arrangements of the six letters of the word LETTER have the two T's not next to each other?

At a stall, 40% of the items sold cost 4 dollars each. Every other item sold cost either 9 dollars or 14 dollars. The mean price of all the items sold was 8.25 dollars. What percent of the items sold cost 14 dollars?

Ana, Ben and Cal each try to solve a puzzle, working independently. The probabilities that they solve it are 1/2, 1/3 and 1/4, respectively. What is the probability that at least one of them solves the puzzle?
The mean of a list of n numbers is 18. When the numbers 30 and 40 are added to the list, the mean of all the numbers becomes 20. What is the value of n?

The number who play chess but not go is twice the number who play both, and the number who play go but not chess is 6 more than the number who play both. How many members play both games?

Seven cards are numbered 1 through 7. Two of the cards are drawn at random at the same time. What is the probability that the sum of the two numbers drawn is even?
What is the value of (1/2)^(-3) - 2^0 ?
If x = 2y and y = -3, what is the value of x^2 - xy ?
The numbers a, b and c satisfy a + b = 7, b + c = 19 and a + c = 16. What is the greatest of the three numbers a, b and c?
What is the sum of all values of x that satisfy x(x - 3) = 4(x - 3) ?

The four-digit number 7A53, in which A stands for a single digit, is divisible by 11. What digit does A stand for?
How many positive integers less than 200 leave the same remainder when divided by 4 as when divided by 6?
For how many positive integers n is the least common multiple of n and 18 equal to 180?
